summary: Metrospaces filed an 8-K disclosing a change of control under a Control Stock Purchase Agreement dated October 6, 2026, with GBS Capital Partners and Oscar Brito selling 1,643,255 Series B and 4.5 Series E preferred shares to Villa Magna, LLC, represented by Maria Salinas. No common stock and no cash purchase price were exchanged; the Company separately agreed to transfer Genesis Series C preferred stock to GBS, conditioned on documentary and valuation proof. Buyer pledged the acquired shares under a covenant agreement to fund an OTC Markets application within 90 days and a FINRA reverse-split package within 120 days. What to watch: satisfaction of Genesis transfer conditions, dilution from preferred conversion, and FINRA/OTC execution risk.
